text: Josh and Renai Lambert have just moved into a new house when their son Dalton climbs into the attic, falls from a ladder, and [slips into a coma no doctor can explain|trigger|cut off and trapped]. Back home, alarms sound on their own, a bloody handprint stains his bed, and Josh's mother dreams of [a red-faced demon in Dalton's room|threat|the devil and dark gods]. The psychic Elise Rainier explains that the boy has wandered too far from his body, lost in [a realm of tortured spirits called The Further|origin|from another world], and [the dead want his empty body|wants|a way into life].
